Name: Download File
Author: admin
Description: Download file from VirusTotal. Supported entities: Filehash. Note: this action requires a VT Enterprise token. Only MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 hashes are supported.

Parameters.Description: Specify the path to the folder, where you want to store the files.
If enabled, action will overwrite the file with the same name.

AIDescription:
### General Description
This action downloads files associated with Filehash entities from VirusTotal. It is designed to retrieve the actual file content for further analysis or storage. Note that this action requires a VirusTotal Enterprise token and supports MD5, SHA-1, and SHA-256 hash formats.

### Flow Description
1. Initializes the VirusTotal manager using the provided API Key and SSL verification settings.
2. Filters the target entities to identify those of type `FILEHASH`.
3. Validates the hash length for each entity to ensure it is a supported format (MD5, SHA-1, or SHA-256).
4. Constructs the target file path and checks if the file already exists. If `Overwrite` is disabled and the file exists, an exception is raised for that entity.
5. Calls the VirusTotal API (`GET /api/v3/files/{entity_hash}/download`) to download the file content associated with the hash.
6. Saves the retrieved content to the specified `Download Folder Path` on the local filesystem.
7. Returns a list of absolute file paths for all successfully downloaded files and provides an execution summary.

### Additional Notes
- This action interacts with the VirusTotal v3 API.
- It only processes entities of type FILEHASH.
- The action will skip hashes that do not match the standard lengths for MD5 (32), SHA-1 (40), or SHA-256 (64).
AiShortDescription: Downloads files associated with Filehash entities from VirusTotal and saves them to a specified local directory.
ParametersDescription:
| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Download Folder Path | String | Yes | Specify the path to the folder, where you want to store the files. |
| Overwrite | Boolean | No | If enabled, action will overwrite the file with the same name. |
